Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
1. Short title rind commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Baluchistan Students Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come, into force
at once.

Provincial funds

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
3. Provincial Funds.‑(1) There shall be created a fund in the
name of Provincial Fund for the welfare of the Students.
(2) The funds shall be raised
in the manner provided under the rules.

Organization of the board

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
4. Organization of the Board.‑(1) There shall be created c
Board in the name of Students Welfare Board with its Headquarters at Quetta.
(2) The Board shall consist of
the following official and non‑official members :
(i) Senior Member, Board of
Revenue, Baluchistan. .
(ii) Secretary Health,
Government of Baluchistan.
(iii) Secretary Finance,
Government of Baluchistan.
(iv) Secretary Education,
Government of Baluchistan.
(v) There shall be three non‑official
members to be nominated by the Government
and notified in the official Gazette from amongst the public and
philanthropists.
(3) The Senior Member, Board of
Revenue, Baluchistan and the Secretary Education,
Government of Baluchistan, shall respectively, be the Chairman and Secretary of
the Board.

Functions of the board

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
5. Functions of the Board.‑(1) The Board shall be responsible
for the operation, collection and
arrangement of the affairs of the funds.
(2) The Board shall provide
financial assistance to Students in distress particularly
for medical treatment.
(3) The Board shall encourage
and subsidize sports amongst the students.
(4) The Board shall provide
financial aid to the students individually or collectively
or in any other manner as it deems fit.

Audit

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
6. Audit.‑The fund shall
be auditable by the Local Fund Audit.

Power to make rules

ORDINANCE II OF 1979
ORDINANCE II OF 1979
BALUCHISTAN STUDENTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979
7. Power to make Rules.‑The Government or the
Board, if so empowered by the Government, may make rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Ordinance.
